name: Ingo Lesson
source:
The main character, a tutor with a fetish for dirty words, likes his students who are interested in him... It's a visual novel that emphasizes conversation, and the concept is not to use obscene language, but rather embarrassed and embarrassed obscene language.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ013946.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名对下流话有特殊嗜好的家教，而他所钟情的学生，也对他抱有好感…本作是一部重视对话的视觉小说，着眼于说话的人如何害羞、难为情地吐出那些露骨字眼。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ013946.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
